newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds post redemptions for two days.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds post redemptions for two days.

text.p: U.S. stock mutual fund posted industrywide redemptions of $226 million for the two days ended May 29 versus inflows of $1.40 billion for the three days ended May 27, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said that aggressive growth funds recorded outflows of $391 million versus inflows of $229 million, while inflows in growth and income funds halved to $440 million versus $892 million.
International funds also saw lower outflows of $501 million versus inflows of $1.09 billion.

Bond funds had redemptions of $91 million versus redemptions of $332 million. Muni funds had outflows of $253 million versus outflows of $196 million, while high yield funds had inflows of $142 million versus inflows of $7 million.
